description: This file implements the SystemInfo class and related nested classes for gathering and managing system information such as network, security, location, device ID, time, and software version within the WPEFramework PluginHost namespace. It includes methods for registration, notification, device ID retrieval, and system info updates.

classes.name: SystemInfo
classes.description: Main class providing system information management, including registration of notifications, device ID retrieval, and update mechanisms.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Internet
classes.description: Represents network-related information such as public IP address and network type.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Security
classes.description: Provides security-related information, specifically the callsign.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Location
classes.description: Contains location details such as timezone, country, region, city, latitude, and longitude.

classes.name: SystemInfo::Id
classes.description: Represents device identification details including identifier, architecture, chipset, and firmware version.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Register
methods.description: Registers a notification client for system info updates.

methods.name: SystemInfo::RawDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address of a network interface, used as a device ID.

methods.name: SystemInfo::Update
methods.description: Triggers an update of system information and notifies registered clients.

methods.name: SystemInfo::BuildTreeHash
methods.description: Returns a hash representing the build tree.
